name: Damsel
ability: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
wakes: never (Minions are woken on the first night, or when they become a Minion, and shown the Damsel token)
interaction: Told: Each Minion is shown the Damsel token.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned, a correct Minion guess does not make good lose (the guess is still used).

jinxes.text: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.

rulings.text: Minions get one guess in total; a wrong guess by any Minion uses it up.
A Demon pretending to be a Minion and guessing does not count.
Minions may guess at any time.
A dead Damsel has no ability, so guessing them does nothing.

test_scenarios.name: Correct guess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Damsel, Eve Witch, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2, Eve publicly guesses Alice is the Damsel.

test_scenarios.name: Wrong guess uses it up
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Damsel, Eve Boomdandy, Frank Goblin, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Eve guesses Bob; later Frank guesses Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: First guess fails and Guess used is placed; the second guess does nothing.

test_scenarios.name: Spy jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Damsel, Eve Spy, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: The Damsel is poisoned by the jinx, so nothing happens.

test_scenarios.name: Dead Damsel
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Damsel (executed day 1), Eve Poisoner, Carol Imp.

test_scenarios.name: Demon guessing
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; only Minion guesses count.
